name: Google TPU v5e: 197 BF16 TFLOPS per chip
methodology: Vendor-published per-chip specification. Single TensorCore with 4 MXUs (128x128 each). 16 GB HBM at 819 GB/s. 256-chip pod on 2D torus with ICI 400 GB/s bidirectional per chip.
notes: Vendor-published peak compute specification. The 197 TFLOPS is the theoretical BF16 peak per chip. No inference throughput (tokens/sec) is published by Google for TPU v5e. The INT8 figure is 393 TOPS (2x BF16). v5e is the cost-optimized part with the lowest compute-to-byte ratio (240 FLOP/byte BF16).
